items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Duke Ellington told Herman Stark and Owrey Madden to go over and hear this kid...

ctx.x: -- they didn't have nobody to come in the Cotton Club to take Duke Ellington's place. So Duke Ellington told Herman Stark and Owrey Madden to go over and hear this kid over at the Savoy Ballroom, "He's a good entertainer. He looks good. He's got a nice personality. And I think he could do something with it."
